$comment: The "did you mean" ranking, as [written, expected] pairs. Two suggesters answer it — word-candidates.js for the word_contract tool and rust/src/diagnostic_hint.rs for the Unknown Word diagnosis — and both tests read this file, so the two cannot rank differently unnoticed. A one-letter slip on a short, medium and long name (each a different distance-ceiling bucket); names with several equally close matches, for the distance-then-name tie-break; an unmatched name, which comes back empty; full-width input, which a Japanese input method produces and which folds to ASCII; and an exact name, which is a match rather than a near-miss of itself.
